frozen_sufficiency_rule.cell_state: Stage 0 CORRECT = valid output + frozen-gold match + no contract violation, all runs
frozen_sufficiency_rule.ladder: cheapest SUFFICIENT tier with all cheaper tiers definitively FAILED; otherwise MINIMUM_UNKNOWN
frozen_sufficiency_rule.tier_FAILED: all tier models tested (INCORRECT/INVALID), zero correct
frozen_sufficiency_rule.tier_UNRESOLVED: no evaluable evidence, or tested failures with untested models remaining
frozen_sufficiency_rule.existence_note: tier sufficient if one route works; cascade must order in-tier routes accordingly
frozen_sufficiency_rule.frontier: T4 supervised only when T1-T3 all definitively FAILED (ladder exhaustion, not absence)
